metadata.question: How much rent does the tenant pay?

citations.quote: The Tenant shall pay a rent of £1,150 per hectare per annum, payable quarterly in advance.

sentences.text: The tenant pays rent of £1,150 per hectare per annum, payable quarterly in advance.

citations.quote: The rent shall be reviewed on every fifth anniversary of the start of the term in line with the Consumer Prices Index.

sentences.text: The rent is reviewed on every fifth anniversary of the start of the term in line with the Consumer Prices Index.
